name: uk-income-tax-sa100
description: UK Income Tax for individuals who file the SA100 Self Assessment return, tax year 2026-27 (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027), with 2025-26 figures for returns filed now. Covers the GBP 12,570 Personal Allowance and its taper above GBP 100,000, the frozen bands and the 20%, 40% and 45% rates, the Welsh rates, the six Scottish bands for 2026-27, the starting rate for savings and the Personal Savings Allowance, the dividend allowance and rates, Marriage Allowance, the High Income Child Benefit Charge, who must file, registration by 5 October, the 31 October and 31 January deadlines, penalties and late payment interest. Trigger on: SA100, personal allowance taper, income tax bands 2026-27, Scottish income tax, marriage allowance, child benefit charge, register for self assessment, late tax return penalty. Out of scope: uk-self-employment-sa103, uk-rental-sa105, uk-capital-gains-sa108, uk-national-insurance, uk-statutory-residence-test, uk-dividends, uk-scottish-income-tax, uk-payments-on-accou
